root_reference_alignment.method: Direct import onto the original reference skeleton; measured root-frame correction aligns orientation and translation through the public animation-data-model API, preserving every other local bone channel and nominal displacement

root_motion_basis_evidence.description: Baked local bone transforms are preserved at import. The measured animation-to-mesh yaw is zero, so no additional dash rotation or scale repair is applied.

axis_evidence.handedness: The measured source-to-Unreal basis is a right-handed to left-handed coordinate conversion; determinant -1 is intentional.

texture_memory_note: Measured decoded source texture bytes are reported in material_and_lod_report.json; runtime GPU memory is benchmarked separately.
